title: Venetian Bronze Shower Basket, 18.75-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Oval Combination Caddy, Matte Black, Allied Brass
description: This 18.75-inch shower basket in Matte Black adds bold, refined contrast while keeping daily essentials organized and off the shower floor. Available in Venetian Bronze. Venetian Bronze presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden. The wall mount design saves space and creates a clean, built-in look in a traditional bathroom. Solid brass construction delivers long-lasting durability, and the heavy-gauge, ventilated solid brass wires are rust proof to promote fast drainage. Concealed screw mounting hardware keeps the installation looking finished. Includes the basket and all installation hardware. A designer finish provides corrosion-free performance and complements classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty.
